waveform.sourceProvenance: Deterministic synthetic stereo tones, decaying kicks and silence. Intentional single-sample overloads are disabled. No recorded music or live input.
waveform.steadyTimerIntervalLimit: Excludes startup through 0.4 s and the interval immediately following a capture or layout change; still a GUI-thread fixture, not DAW performance.
waveform.captureMethod: Real JUCE editor component snapshots at 1x logical size; validates raster waveform and UI. The Studio OpenGL child is not captured by this method.
waveform.styleComparison: After input stops, frozen Silk/Prism/Trace use identical samples, window, dimensions, palette and gain. Interior hashes exclude controls, titles, axes and levels. Repeated Prism/Trace captures must match, and returning to Silk must restore its interior exactly.
waveform.axisVerification: Zoom screenshots include the painted amplitude axis; expectedAmplitudeAxisLimit records 1, 0.5 or 0.25 for visual review. No OCR or numeric inference from pixels is performed.
waveform.timingLimit: Developer GUI-thread feed and PNG captures affect timer intervals; these are QA observations, not real-time audio or DAW performance measurements.
waveform.deliveryClock: Prefill + floor(monotonic elapsed seconds * 48000), completed exactly in blocks of at most 800 samples until the explicit input stop.
